recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Future mapping changes should preserve StructureDefinition.mapping as the mapping-specification declaration and ElementDefinition.mapping as the element-level mapping expression unless a new work-group decision changes that model.
issue_request: FHIR-12323 asked to align StructureDefinition.mapping and ElementDefinition.mapping or clarify their correlation. It was Published as Not Persuasive with Modification: the components are not supposed to align one-for-one, but comment should be added to ElementDefinition.mapping.
initial_application: The Jira application comment cites SVN revision 11548. In git-svn history, c0df469417b5ac953e7c5295d192eff6d12c484a added ElementDefinition.mapping.comment to source/datatypes/elementdefinition.xml as a 0..1 string child, and 21fefc2247268b284d2791adbe9c959fec78db43 corrected the wording to 'its use'.
additional_context: The active current source still defines ElementDefinition.mapping with identity, language, map, and comment, and StructureDefinition.mapping with identity, uri, name, and comment, preserving the distinct declaration-vs-expression roles described by the Jira resolution. Later Published issue FHIR-28141 changed ElementDefinition.mapping.comment from string to markdown, so the current markdown datatype is intentional later history. FHIR-5749 is a same-change-family DataElement/ElementDefinition mapping issue already represented on the combined branch.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit because no source change is needed. The current source already has ElementDefinition.mapping.comment, and adding StructureDefinition-style children to ElementDefinition.mapping would contradict the final FHIR-12323 resolution.
